request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation states the underlying maintenance grant is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time Dolos maintainer for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient access to chain data without running a traditional full node.

The proposal says Dolos connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with existing tooling.
The proposal reports Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The proposal states the maintainer will handle dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, community communication, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal asserts Dolos aligns with Pillar 2 focus area A.3 for Developer Experience and open-source maintenance incentives.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The proposal says funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury smart contracts with Intersect administration, an external Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard for community auditing.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to maintain Dolos for another year through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, presenting Dolos as open-source Cardano infrastructure with stated developer utility, prior delivery history, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and oversight mechanisms.
